answer: Carrier attestation: (1) each identity enrolls one eSIM profile, and a telecom verifier checks that profile's GSMA certificate and its IMEI pairing against the carrier gateway every epoch. (2) Two identities reporting one IMEI, or a reused profile, are voided together and their $500 sponsor bond is slashed. (3) A handset with a burned IMEI costs $35 plus $9 per profile, so 5,000 fakes cost $220,000 in devices and contracts. An honest operator holds one line, a thin plume of traffic on a basalt mast; a farm pays in full per fake, and five thousand radios cannot sing one sonnet.
